name: ABS
description: The ABS function returns the absolute value of a number value or of a duration value .

name: ACCRINT
syntax: ACCRINT(issue, first, settle, annual-rate, par, frequency, days-basis)
description: The ACCRINT function returns the accrued interest on a security that pays periodic interest.

name: ACCRINTM
description: The ACCRINTM function calculates the total accrued interest added to the purchase price of a security and paid to the seller when the security pays interest only at maturity.

name: ACOS
description: The ACOS function returns the inverse cosine (arccosine) of a number.

name: ACOSH
description: The ACOSH function returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine (hyperbolic arccosine) of a number.

name: ACOT
description: The ACOT function returns the inverse cotangent (arccotangent) of a number.

name: ACOTH
description: The ACOTH function returns the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a number.

name: ADDRESS
description: The ADDRESS function constructs a cell address string from separate row, column, and table identifiers.

name: AND
description: The AND function returns the boolean value TRUE if all arguments are true, and the boolean value FALSE otherwise.

name: AREAS
description: The AREAS function returns the number of ranges the function references.

name: ARRAYTOTEXT
description: The ARRAYTOTEXT function returns the textual form of an array .

name: ASIN
description: The ASIN function returns the arcsine (the inverse sine) of a number.

name: ASINH
description: The ASINH function returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.

name: ATAN
description: The ATAN function returns the inverse tangent (arctangent) of a number.

name: ATAN2
description: The ATAN2 function returns the angle, relative to the positive x-axis, of the line passing through the origin and the specified point.

name: ATANH
description: The ATANH function returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.

name: AVEDEV
description: The AVEDEV function returns the average of the difference of a set of numbers from their average (arithmetic mean).

name: AVERAGE
description: The AVERAGE function returns the average (arithmetic mean) of a set of numbers.

name: AVERAGEA
description: The AVERAGEA function returns the average (arithmetic mean) of a set containing any value .

name: AVERAGEIF
description: The AVERAGEIF function returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the cells in a set that meet a given condition .

name: AVERAGEIFS
description: The AVERAGEIFS function returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the cells in a given set where one or more sets meet one or more related conditions .

name: BASETONUM
description: The BASETONUM function converts a number of the specified base into a number in base 10.

name: BESSELJ
description: The BESSELJ function returns the integer Bessel function J n (x).

name: BESSELY
description: The BESSELY function returns the integer Bessel function Y n (x).

name: BETADIST
description: The BETADIST function returns the cumulative beta distribution probability value.

name: BETAINV
description: The BETAINV function returns the inverse of the given cumulative beta distribution probability value.

name: BIN2DEC
description: The BIN2DEC function converts a binary number to the corresponding decimal number.

name: BIN2HEX
description: The BIN2HEX function converts a binary number to the corresponding hexadecimal number.

name: BIN2OCT
description: The BIN2OCT function converts a binary number to the corresponding octal number.

name: BINOMDIST
description: The BINOMDIST function returns the binomial distribution of the specified type.

name: BITAND
description: The BITAND function returns the bitwise AND of two numbers.

name: BITLSHIFT
description: The BITLSHIFT function returns a number shifted left by the specified number of bit positions.

name: BITOR
description: The BITOR function returns the bitwise OR of two numbers.

name: BITRSHIFT
description: The BITRSHIFT function returns a number shifted right by the specified number of bit positions.

name: BITXOR
description: The BITXOR function returns the bitwise XOR of two numbers.

name: BONDDURATION
syntax: BONDDURATION(settle, maturity, annual-rate, annual-yield, frequency, days-basis)
description: The BONDDURATION function returns the weighted average of the present value of the cash flows for an assumed par value of $100.

name: BONDMDURATION
syntax: BONDMDURATION(settle, maturity, annual-rate, annual-yield, frequency, days-basis)
description: The BONDMDURATION function returns the modified weighted average of the present value of the cash flows for an assumed par value of $100.

name: BYCOL
description: The BYCOL function applies a LAMBDA function to each column and returns an array of the results.

name: BYROW
description: The BYROW function applies a LAMBDA function to each row and returns an array of the results.

name: CEILING
description: The CEILING function rounds a number away from 0 to the nearest multiple of the specified factor.

name: CHAR
description: The CHAR function returns the character that corresponds to a decimal Unicode character code.

name: CHIDIST
description: The CHIDIST function returns the one-tailed probability of the chi-square distribution.

name: CHIINV
description: The CHIINV function returns the inverse of the one-tailed probability of the chi-square distribution.

name: CHITEST
description: The CHITEST function returns the value from the chi-square distribution for the given data.

name: CHOOSE
description: The CHOOSE function returns a value from a collection of values based on a specified index value.

name: CHOOSECOLS
description: The CHOOSECOLS function returns specific columns from an array .

name: CHOOSEROWS
description: The CHOOSEROWS function returns specific rows from an array .

name: CLEAN
description: The CLEAN function removes most common nonprinting characters (Unicode character codes 0–31) from text.

name: CODE
description: The CODE function returns the decimal Unicode number of the first character in a specified string.

name: COLUMN
description: The COLUMN function returns the column number of the column containing a specified cell.

name: COLUMNS
description: The COLUMNS function returns the number of columns included in a specified collection of cells.

name: COMBIN
description: The COMBIN function returns the number of different ways you can combine a number of items into groups of a specific size, ignoring the order within the groups.

name: COMBINA
description: The COMBINA function returns the number of different ways you can combine a number of items into groups of a specific size, where repetition is allowed and the order within the groups is ignored.

name: CONCAT
description: The CONCAT function joins (concatenates) values or the contents of cell ranges or strings.

name: CONCATENATE
description: The CONCATENATE function joins (concatenates) values or the contents of referenced cells.

name: CONFIDENCE
description: The CONFIDENCE function returns a value for creating a statistical confidence interval for a sample from a population with a known standard deviation.

name: CONVERT
description: The CONVERT function converts a number from one measurement system to its corresponding value in another measurement system.

name: CORREL
description: The CORREL function returns the correlation between two sets using linear regression analysis.

name: COS
description: The COS function returns the cosine of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: COSH
description: The COSH function returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

name: COT
description: The COT function returns the cotangent of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: COTH
description: The COTH function returns the hyperbolic cotangent of a number.

name: COUNT
description: The COUNT function returns the number of its arguments that contain numbers, numeric expressions, or dates.

name: COUNTA
description: The COUNTA function returns the number of its arguments that are not empty.

name: COUNTBLANK
description: The COUNTBLANK function returns the number of cells in a collection that are empty.

name: COUNTIF
description: The COUNTIF function returns the number of cells in a collection that satisfy a given condition .

name: COUNTIFS
description: The COUNTIFS function returns the number of cells in one or more collections that satisfy given conditions (one condition per collection).

name: COUNTMATCHES
description: The COUNTMATCHES function returns a number value representing the number of times a given substring appears in the original string value.

name: COUPDAYBS
description: The COUPDAYBS function returns the number of days between the beginning of the coupon period in which settlement occurs and the settlement date.

name: COUPDAYS
description: The COUPDAYS function returns the number of days in the coupon period in which settlement occurs.

name: COUPDAYSNC
description: The COUPDAYSNC function returns the number of days between the settlement date and the end of the coupon period in which settlement occurs.

name: COUPNUM
description: The COUPNUM function returns the number of coupons remaining to be paid between the settlement date and the maturity date.

name: COVAR
description: The COVAR function returns the covariance of two sets of number values .

name: CRITBINOM
description: The CRITBINOM function returns the smallest value for which the cumulative binomial distribution is greater than or equal to a given value.

name: CSC
description: The CSC function returns the cosecant of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: CSCH
description: The CSCH function returns the hyperbolic cosecant of a number.

name: CUMIPMT
syntax: CUMIPMT(periodic-rate, num-periods, present-value, starting-per, ending-per, when-due)
description: The CUMIPMT function returns the total interest included in loan or annuity payments over a chosen time interval based on fixed periodic payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: CUMPRINC
syntax: CUMPRINC(periodic-rate, num-periods, present-value, starting-per, ending-per, when-due)
description: The CUMPRINC function returns the total principal included in loan or annuity payments over a chosen time interval based on fixed periodic payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: CURRENCY
description: The CURRENCY function returns data from the previous market day’s close about the exchange rate between two currencies, retrieved remotely via the internet.

name: CURRENCYCODE
description: The CURRENCYCODE function returns the currency code of a given currency value, or the currency code for the language and region set for the computer or for the current document.

name: CURRENCYCONVERT
description: The CURRENCYCONVERT function returns the price of a given currency value in a different currency, using exchange rate data from the previous market day’s close, retrieved remotely via the internet.

name: CURRENCYH
description: The CURRENCYH function returns historical data on the exchange rate between two currencies for a given date.

name: DATE
description: The DATE function combines separate values for year, month, and day and returns a date/time value .

name: DATEDIF
description: The DATEDIF function returns the number of days, months, or years between two dates.

name: DATEVALUE
description: The DATEVALUE function returns a date/time value for a given date string .

name: DAY
description: The DAY function returns the day of the month for a given date/time value or date string .

name: DAYNAME
description: The DAYNAME function returns the name of the day of the week for a given date/time value , date string , or number value .

name: DAYS
description: The DAYS function returns the number of days between two date/time values or date strings .

name: DAYS360
description: The DAYS360 function returns the number of days between two dates based on twelve 30-day months and a 360-day year.

name: DB
description: The DB function returns the amount of depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the fixed-declining balance method.

name: DDB
description: The DDB function returns the amount of depreciation of an asset based on a specified depreciation rate.

name: DEC2BIN
description: The DEC2BIN function converts a decimal number to the corresponding binary number.

name: DEC2HEX
description: The DEC2HEX function converts a decimal number to the corresponding hexadecimal number.

name: DEC2OCT
description: The DEC2OCT function converts a decimal number to the corresponding octal number.

name: DEGREES
description: The DEGREES function returns the number of degrees in an angle expressed in radians.

name: DELTA
description: The DELTA function determines whether two number values are exactly equal.

name: DEVSQ
description: The DEVSQ function returns the sum of the squares of deviations of a set of numbers from their average (arithmetic mean).

name: DISC
description: The DISC function returns the annual discount rate of a security that pays no interest and is sold at a discount to its redemption value.

name: DOLLAR
description: The DOLLAR function returns a string formatted as currency from a given number value .

name: DROP
description: The DROP function excludes a specified number of rows or columns from the start or end of an array .

name: DUR2DAYS
description: The DUR2DAYS function converts a duration value to a number of days.

name: DUR2HOURS
description: The DUR2HOURS function converts a duration value to a number of hours.

name: DUR2MILLISECONDS
description: The DUR2MILLISECONDS function converts a duration value to a number of milliseconds.

name: DUR2MINUTES
description: The DUR2MINUTES function converts a duration value to a number of minutes.

name: DUR2SECONDS
description: The DUR2SECONDS function converts a duration value to a number of seconds.

name: DUR2WEEKS
description: The DUR2WEEKS function converts a duration value to a number of weeks.

name: DURATION
syntax: DURATION(weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds)
description: The DURATION function combines separate values for weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds and returns a duration value .

name: EDATE
description: The EDATE function returns a date/time value that is some number of months before or after a given date.

name: EFFECT
description: The EFFECT function returns the effective annual interest rate from the nominal annual interest rate based on the number of compounding periods per year.

name: EOMONTH
description: The EOMONTH function returns a date/time value that is the last day of the month, some number of months before or after a given date.

name: ERF
description: The ERF function returns the error function integrated between two values.

name: ERFC
description: The ERFC function returns the complementary ERF function integrated between a given lower bound and infinity.

name: EVEN
description: The EVEN function rounds a number away from 0 to the next even number.

name: EXACT
description: The EXACT function returns TRUE if the argument strings are identical in case and content.

name: EXP
description: The EXP function returns e (the base of natural logarithms) raised to the specified power.

name: EXPAND
description: The EXPAND function adds rows or columns to an array based on specified dimensions.

name: EXPONDIST
description: The EXPONDIST function returns the exponential distribution of the specified type.

name: FACT
description: The FACT function returns the factorial of a number.

name: FACTDOUBLE
description: The FACTDOUBLE function returns the double factorial of a number.

name: FALSE
description: The FALSE function returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: FDIST
description: The FDIST function returns the F probability distribution.

name: FILTER
description: The FILTER function filters an array based on specified criteria.

name: FIND
description: The FIND function returns the starting position of one string within another.

name: FINV
description: The FINV function returns the inverse of the F probability distribution.

name: FISHER
description: The FISHER function returns the Fisher transformation of a number value .

name: FISHERINV
description: The FISHERINV function returns the inverse of the Fisher transformation of a number value .

name: FIXED
description: The FIXED function rounds a number to the specified number value of decimal places and then returns the result as a string value.

name: FLOOR
description: The FLOOR function rounds a number toward 0 to the nearest multiple of the specified factor.

name: FORECAST
description: The FORECAST function returns the forecasted y value for a given x based on sample values using linear regression analysis.

name: FORMULATEXT
description: The FORMULATEXT function returns a formula as a text string.

name: FREQUENCY
description: The FREQUENCY function returns an array of how often data values occur within a collection of interval values.

name: FV
description: The FV function returns the future value of an investment based on a series of regular periodic cash flows (payments of a constant amount and all cash flows at constant intervals) and at a fixed interest rate.

name: GAMMA
description: The GAMMA function returns the gamma function value of a number value .

name: GAMMADIST
description: The GAMMADIST function returns the gamma distribution of the specified type.

name: GAMMAINV
description: The GAMMAINV function returns the inverse gamma cumulative distribution.

name: GAMMALN
description: The GAMMALN function returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function, G(x).

name: GCD
description: The GCD function returns the greatest common divisor of a collection of number values .

name: GEOMEAN
description: The GEOMEAN function returns the geometric mean of the specified number values .

name: GESTEP
description: The GESTEP function determines if one number value is greater than or exactly equal to the second number value.

name: GETPIVOTDATA
syntax: GETPIVOTDATA(aggregate-field, pivot-cell, field-name, item, field-name…, item…)
description: The GETPIVOTDATA function returns aggregate data from a pivot table.

name: HARMEAN
description: The HARMEAN function returns the harmonic mean of the specified number values .

name: HEX2BIN
description: The HEX2BIN function converts a hexadecimal number to the corresponding binary number.

name: HEX2DEC
description: The HEX2DEC function converts a hexadecimal number to the corresponding decimal number.

name: HEX2OCT
description: The HEX2OCT function converts a hexadecimal number to the corresponding octal number.

name: HLOOKUP
description: The HLOOKUP function returns a value from a collection of rows by using the top row of values to pick a column and a row number to pick a row within that column.

name: HOUR
description: The HOUR function returns the hour for a given date/time value or time string .

name: HSTACK
description: The HSTACK function adjoins arrays horizontally and in sequence to form a larger array.

name: HYPERLINK
description: The HYPERLINK function creates a clickable link that opens a webpage or new email message.

name: IF
description: The IF function returns one of two values, depending on whether a specified expression evaluates to a boolean value of TRUE or FALSE.

name: IFERROR
description: The IFERROR function returns a value that you specify if a given value evaluates to an error; otherwise it returns the given value.

name: IFS
description: The IFS function checks specified expressions and returns a value based on the first condition that evaluates to a boolean value of TRUE.

name: INDEX
description: The INDEX function returns the value in the cell located at the intersection of the specified row and column within a collection of cells or from an array returned by an array function .

name: INDIRECT
description: The INDIRECT function returns the contents of a cell or range referenced by an address specified as a string value .

name: INT
description: The INT function returns the nearest integer that is less than or equal to the number.

name: INTERCEPT
description: The INTERCEPT function returns the y-intercept of the best-fit line for the collection using linear regression analysis.

name: INTERSECT.RANGES
description: The INTERSECT.RANGES function returns a single value or an array of values contained at the intersection of the specified collections .

name: INTRATE
description: The INTRATE function returns the effective annual interest rate for a security that pays interest only at maturity.

name: IPMT
syntax: IPMT(periodic-rate, period, num-periods, present-value, future-value, when-due)
description: The IPMT function returns the interest portion of a specified loan or annuity payment based on fixed, periodic payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: IRR
description: The IRR function returns the internal rate of return for an investment that is based on a series of potentially irregular cash flows (payments that do not need to be a constant amount) that occur at regular time intervals.

name: ISBLANK
description: The ISBLANK function returns the boolean value TRUE if the specified cell is empty and the boolean value FALSE otherwise.

name: ISDATE
description: The ISDATE function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given expression evaluates to a date; otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: ISERROR
description: The ISERROR function returns the boolean value TRUE if a given expression evaluates to an error and the boolean value FALSE otherwise.

name: ISEVEN
description: The ISEVEN function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given number is even (leaves no remainder when divided by 2); otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: ISNUMBER
description: The ISNUMBER function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given expression evaluates to a number; otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: ISNUMBERORDATE
description: The ISNUMBERORDATE function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given expression evaluates to a number or date; otherwise, it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: ISODD
description: The ISODD function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given number is odd (leaves a remainder when divided by 2); otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: ISOMITTED
description: The ISOMITTED function determines if the parameter in a LAMBDA function has been passed to the LAMBDA.

name: ISOWEEKNUM
description: The ISOWEEKNUM function returns the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) week number for a specific date.

name: ISPMT
description: The ISPMT function returns the periodic interest portion for a fixed-rate loan where an equal principal reduction occurs at the beginning of each period and an interest payment on the outstanding balance is made at the end of each period.

name: ISTEXT
description: The ISTEXT function returns the boolean value TRUE if the given expression evaluates to a string; otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: LAMBDA.APPLY
description: The LAMBDA.APPLY function is used to test LAMBDA functions.

name: LARGE
description: The LARGE function returns the n th -largest value within a collection.

name: LCM
description: The LCM function returns the least common multiple of a collection of number values .

name: LEFT
description: The LEFT function returns a string value consisting of the specified number of characters from the left end of a given string value.

name: LEN
description: The LEN function returns the number of graphemes in a string value .

name: LINEST
description: The LINEST function returns an array of the statistics for a straight line that best fits the given data using the least squares method.

name: LN
description: The LN function returns the natural logarithm of a number (the power to which e must be raised to result in the number).

name: LOG
description: The LOG function returns the logarithm of a number using a specified base.

name: LOG10
description: The LOG10 function returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

name: LOGINV
description: The LOGINV function returns the inverse of the log-normal cumulative distribution function of x.

name: LOGNORMDIST
description: The LOGNORMDIST function returns the log-normal distribution.

name: LOOKUP
description: The LOOKUP function finds a match for a given search value in one collection , and then returns the value in the cell with the same relative position in a second collection.

name: LOWER
description: The LOWER function returns a string value that is entirely lowercase, regardless of the case of the characters in the specified string value.

name: MAKEARRAY
description: The MAKEARRAY function returns an array of numbers with a specified number of rows and columns calculated by a LAMBDA function.

name: MAP
description: The MAP function maps each value in an array to a new value determined by a LAMBDA function, and returns a new array.

name: MATCH
description: The MATCH function returns the position of a value within a collection .

name: MAX
description: The MAX function returns the largest numeric value in a set of number values , date/time values or duration values .

name: MAXA
description: The MAXA function returns the largest numeric value in a set containing any values .

name: MAXIFS
description: The MAXIFS function returns the largest numeric value in a range of cells, determined by a set of criteria.

name: MDETERM
description: The MDETERM function returns the determinant of a matrix.

name: MEDIAN
description: The MEDIAN function returns the median value in a set of numbers.

name: MID
description: The MID function returns a string value consisting of the given number of characters from a string value starting at the specified position.

name: MIN
description: The MIN function returns the smallest numeric value in a set of number values , date/time values , or duration values .

name: MINA
description: The MINA function returns the smallest numeric value in a set containing any values .

name: MINIFS
description: The MINIFS function returns the smallest numeric value in a range of cells, determined by a set of criteria.

name: MINUTE
description: The MINUTE function returns the minutes for a given date/time value or time string .

name: MINVERSE
description: The MINVERSE function returns the inverse matrix of a matrix.

name: MIRR
description: The MIRR function returns the modified internal rate of return for an investment that is based on a series of potentially irregular cash flows (payments that do not need to be a constant amount) that occur at regular time intervals.

name: MMULT
description: The MMULT function returns the matrix product of two matrices.

name: MOD
description: The MOD function returns the remainder from a division.

name: MODE
description: The MODE function returns the most frequently occurring value in a set of numeric values.

name: MONTH
description: The MONTH function returns the month for a given date/time value or date string .

name: MONTHNAME
description: The MONTHNAME function returns the name of the month for a given number value .

name: MROUND
description: The MROUND function rounds a number to the nearest multiple of a specified factor.

name: MULTINOMIAL
description: The MULTINOMIAL function returns the multinomial coefficient of the given numbers.

name: MUNIT
description: The MUNIT function returns a unit matrix of a specified dimension.

name: NEGBINOMDIST
description: The NEGBINOMDIST function returns the negative binomial distribution.

name: NETWORKDAYS
description: The NETWORKDAYS function returns the number of working days between two dates.

name: NOMINAL
description: The NOMINAL function returns the nominal annual interest rate from the effective annual interest rate based on the number of compounding periods per year.

name: NORMDIST
description: The NORMDIST function returns the normal distribution of the specified type.

name: NORMINV
description: The NORMINV function returns the inverse of the cumulative normal distribution.

name: NORMSDIST
description: The NORMSDIST function returns the standard normal distribution.

name: NORMSINV
description: The NORMSINV function returns the inverse of the cumulative standard normal distribution.

name: NOT
description: The NOT function returns the opposite of the boolean value of a specified expression.

name: NOW
description: The NOW function returns a date/time value that’s the current time in the file’s time zone (see Notes below).

name: NPER
description: The NPER function returns the number of payment periods for a loan or annuity based on a series of regular periodic cash flows (payments of a constant amount and all cash flows at constant intervals) and at a fixed interest rate.

name: NPV
description: The NPV function returns the net present value of an investment based on a series of potentially irregular cash flows that occur at regular time intervals.

name: NUMTOBASE
description: The NUMTOBASE function converts a number from base 10 into a number in the specified base.

name: OCT2BIN
description: The OCT2BIN function converts an octal number to the corresponding binary number.

name: OCT2DEC
description: The OCT2DEC function converts an octal number to the corresponding decimal number.

name: OCT2HEX
description: The OCT2HEX function converts an octal number to the corresponding hexadecimal number.

name: ODD
description: The ODD function rounds a number away from 0 to the next odd number.

name: OFFSET
description: The OFFSET function returns an array of cells that is the specified number of rows and columns away from the specified base cell.

name: OR
description: The OR function returns the boolean value TRUE if any argument is true; otherwise it returns the boolean value FALSE.

name: PEARSON
description: The PEARSON function returns the Pearson product-moment correlation coefficient for two sets of values.

name: PERCENTILE
description: The PERCENTILE function returns the value within a set of numeric values that corresponds to a particular percentile.

name: PERCENTRANK
description: The PERCENTRANK function returns the rank of a value in a set as a percentage of the set.

name: PERMUT
description: The PERMUT function returns the number of permutations for a given number of objects that can be selected from a total number of objects.

name: PERMUTATIONA
description: The PERMUTATIONA function returns the number of permutations for a given number of objects selected from a total number of objects, where repetition is allowed.

name: PHI
description: The PHI function returns the value of the probability density function for a standard normal distribution at a specified value.

name: PI
description: The PI function returns the approximate value of π (pi), the ratio of a circle’s circumference to its diameter.

name: PLAINTEXT
description: The PLAINTEXT function returns a string value stripped of any rich text attributes in the input value.

name: PMT
description: The PMT function returns the fixed periodic payment for a loan or annuity based on a series of regular periodic cash flows (payments of a constant amount and all cash flows at constant intervals) and a fixed interest rate.

name: POISSON
description: The POISSON function returns the Poisson distribution probability for a given number of events.

name: POLYNOMIAL
description: The POLYNOMIAL function evaluates a polynomial at a given point.

name: POWER
description: The POWER function returns a number raised to a power.

name: PPMT
syntax: PPMT(periodic-rate, period, num-periods, present-value, future-value, when-due)
description: The PPMT function returns the principal portion of a specified loan or annuity payment based on fixed periodic payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: PRICE
syntax: PRICE(settle, maturity, annual-rate, annual-yield, redemption, frequency, days-basis)
description: The PRICE function returns the price of a security that pays periodic interest per $100 of redemption (par) value.

name: PRICEDISC
description: The PRICEDISC function returns the price of a security that is sold at a discount to redemption value and does not pay interest per $100 of redemption (par) value.

name: PRICEMAT
syntax: PRICEMAT(settle, maturity, issue, annual-rate, annual-yield, days-basis)
description: The PRICEMAT function returns the price of a security that pays interest only at maturity per $100 of redemption (par) value.

name: PROB
description: The PROB function returns the probability of a collection of values, if you know the probabilities of the individual values.

name: PRODUCT
description: The PRODUCT function returns the product of a collection of number values .

name: PROPER
description: The PROPER function returns a string value where the first letter of each word is uppercase and all remaining characters are lowercase, regardless of the case of the characters in the specified string value.

name: PV
description: The PV function returns the present value of an investment or annuity based on a series of regular periodic cash flows (payments of a constant amount and all cash flows at constant intervals) and at a fixed interest rate.

name: QUARTILE
description: The QUARTILE function returns the value for the specified quartile from a given set of numbers.

name: QUOTIENT
description: The QUOTIENT function returns the integer quotient of two numbers.

name: RADIANS
description: The RADIANS function returns the number of radians in an angle expressed in degrees.

name: RAND
description: The RAND function returns a random number that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.

name: RANDARRAY
description: The RANDARRAY function returns an array of random numbers based on your specifications.

name: RANDBETWEEN
description: The RANDBETWEEN function returns a random integer within the specified range.

name: RANK
description: The RANK function returns the rank of a value within a set of numeric values.

name: RATE
syntax: RATE(num-periods, payment, present-value, future-value, when-due, estimate)
description: The RATE function returns the interest rate of an investment, loan, or annuity based on a series of regular periodic cash flows (payments of a constant amount and all cash flows at constant intervals) and at a fixed interest rate.

name: RECEIVED
description: The RECEIVED function returns the maturity value for a security that pays interest only at maturity.

name: REDUCE
description: The REDUCE function returns a value for an array calculated by a LAMBDA function.

name: REFERENCE.NAME
description: The REFERENCE.NAME function returns a string representation of the given cell reference.

name: REGEX
description: The REGEX function enables usage of regular expressions in other text and conditional functions.

name: REGEX.EXTRACT
description: The REGEX.EXTRACT function returns the matches or capture groups in a match of a given regular expression in a source string.

name: REPLACE
description: The REPLACE function returns a string value where a specified number of characters of a given string value have been replaced with a new string value.

name: REPT
description: The REPT function returns a string value that contains a given string value repeated a specified number of times.

name: RIGHT
description: The RIGHT function returns a string value consisting of the specified number of characters from the right end of a given string value.

name: ROMAN
description: The ROMAN function converts a number to Roman numerals.

name: ROUND
description: The ROUND function returns a number rounded to the specified number of places.

name: ROUNDDOWN
description: The ROUNDDOWN function returns a number rounded toward 0 to the specified number of places.

name: ROUNDUP
description: The ROUNDUP function returns a number rounded away from 0 to the specified number of places.

name: ROW
description: The ROW function returns the row number of the row containing a specified cell or range of cells.

name: ROWS
description: The ROWS function returns the number of rows included in a specified collection of cells.

name: RSQ
description: The RSQ function returns the R-squared value (coefficient of determination) of the best-fit linear regression line through a set of data points.

name: SCAN
description: The SCAN function scans an array and returns intermediate values calculated by a LAMBDA function.

name: SEARCH
description: The SEARCH function returns the starting position of one string value within another, ignoring case and allowing wildcards .

name: SEC
description: The SEC function returns the secant of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: SECH
description: The SECH function returns the hyperbolic secant of a number.

name: SECOND
description: The SECOND function returns the seconds for a given date/time value or time string .

name: SEQUENCE
description: The SEQUENCE function returns an array of sequential, numeric values based on your specifications.

name: SERIESSUM
description: The SERIESSUM function computes and returns the sum of a power series.

name: SIGN
description: The SIGN function returns 1 when the argument number is positive, –1 when it is negative, and 0 when it is zero.

name: SIN
description: The SIN function returns the sine of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: SINH
description: The SINH function returns the hyperbolic sine of the specified number.

name: SLN
description: The SLN function returns the depreciation of an asset for a single period using the straight-line method.

name: SLOPE
description: The SLOPE function returns the slope of the best-fit line for the set using linear regression analysis.

name: SMALL
description: The SMALL function returns the n th -smallest value within a set of numeric values.

name: SORT
description: The SORT function sorts an array .

name: SORTBY
description: The SORTBY function sorts an array based on the values in another array .

name: SQRT
description: The SQRT function returns the square root of a number value .

name: SQRTPI
description: The SQRTPI function returns the square root of a number value after it has been multiplied by π (pi).

name: STANDARDIZE
description: The STANDARDIZE function returns a normalized value from a distribution characterized by a given mean and standard deviation.

name: STDEV
description: The STDEV function returns the standard deviation—a measure of dispersion—of a set of numeric values based on their sample (unbiased) variance.

name: STDEVA
description: The STDEVA function returns the standard deviation—a measure of dispersion—of a set containing any values , based on the sample (unbiased) variance.

name: STDEVP
description: The STDEVP function returns the standard deviation—a measure of dispersion—of a set of numeric values based on their population (true) variance.

name: STDEVPA
description: The STDEVPA function returns the standard deviation—a measure of dispersion—of a set of any values , based on the population (true) variance.

name: STOCK
description: The STOCK function returns data from the previous market day’s close about a given stock, retrieved remotely via the internet.

name: STOCKH
description: The STOCKH function returns historical price information about a stock for a given date, retrieved remotely via the internet.

name: STRIPDURATION
description: The STRIPDURATION function evaluates any value and returns either the number of days represented, if a duration value , or the specified value.

name: SUBSTITUTE
description: The SUBSTITUTE function returns a string value where the specified characters of a given string value have been replaced with a new string value.

name: SUBTOTAL
description: The SUBTOTAL function returns a subtotal for a range of cells.

name: SUM
description: The SUM function returns the sum of a collection of numbers.

name: SUMIF
description: The SUMIF function returns the sum of a collection of numbers, including only numbers that satisfy a specified condition .

name: SUMIFS
description: The SUMIFS function returns the sum of the cells in a collection where the test values meet the given conditions .

name: SUMPRODUCT
description: The SUMPRODUCT function returns the sum of the products of corresponding numbers in one or more collections.

name: SUMSQ
description: The SUMSQ function returns the sum of the squares of a collection consisting of number values .

name: SUMX2MY2
description: The SUMX2MY2 function returns the sum of the difference of the squares of corresponding values in two collections.

name: SUMX2PY2
description: The SUMX2PY2 function returns the sum of the squares of corresponding values in two collections.

name: SUMXMY2
description: The SUMXMY2 function returns the sum of the squares of the differences between corresponding values in two collections.

name: SWITCH
description: The SWITCH function evaluates a value against a list, and returns a result that corresponds with either the first matching value or an optional value if there is no match.

name: SYD
description: The SYD function returns the amount of depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the sum-of-the-years-digits method.

name: T
description: The T function returns the text contained in a cell.

name: TAKE
description: The TAKE function returns a specific number of rows and columns from an array .

name: TAN
description: The TAN function returns the tangent of an angle that is expressed in radians.

name: TANH
description: The TANH function returns the hyperbolic tangent of the specified number.

name: TDIST
description: The TDIST function returns the probability from Student’s t-distribution.

name: TEXTAFTER
description: The TEXTAFTER function returns a string value consisting of all characters that appear after a given substring in the original string value.

name: TEXTBEFORE
description: The TEXTBEFORE function returns a string value consisting of all characters that appear before a given substring in the original string value.

name: TEXTBETWEEN
description: The TEXTBETWEEN function returns a string value consisting of all characters that appear between two given substrings in the original string value.

name: TEXTJOIN
description: The TEXTJOIN function combines the contents of cell ranges or strings with a specified delimiter between each value.

name: TEXTSPLIT
syntax: TEXTSPLIT(string, column-delimiter, row-delimiter, ignore-empty, case-sensitive, pad-with)
description: The TEXTSPLIT function splits the contents of a cell or string by a specified delimiter.

name: TIME
description: The TIME function converts separate number values for hours, minutes, and seconds into a date/time value .

name: TIMEVALUE
description: The TIMEVALUE function returns the time as a decimal fraction of a 24-hour day for a given date/time value or time string .

name: TINV
description: The TINV function returns the t value (a function of the probability and degrees of freedom) from Student’s t-distribution.

name: TOCOL
description: The TOCOL function returns an array in a single column.

name: TODAY
description: The TODAY function returns the current date in the file’s time zone (see Notes below).

name: TOROW
description: The TOROW function returns an array in a single row.

name: TRANSPOSE
description: The TRANSPOSE function returns a vertical collection of cells as a horizontal array of cells, or vice versa.

name: TRIM
description: The TRIM function returns a string based on a given string, after removing extra spaces.

name: TRUE
description: The TRUE function returns the boolean value TRUE.

name: TRUNC
description: The TRUNC function truncates a number to the specified number of digits.

name: TTEST
description: The TTEST function returns the probability associated with Student’s t-test, based on the t-distribution function.

name: UNION.RANGES
description: The UNION.RANGES function returns an array that represents a collection representing the union of the specified collections.

name: UNIQUE
description: The UNIQUE function returns each individual value present in an array .

name: UPPER
description: The UPPER function returns a string value that is entirely uppercase, regardless of the case of the characters in the specified string value.

name: VALUE
description: The VALUE function returns a number value , even if the argument is formatted as text.

name: VAR
description: The VAR function returns the sample (unbiased) variance—a measure of dispersion—of a set of numeric values.

name: VARA
description: The VARA function returns the sample (unbiased) variance—a measure of dispersion—of a collection of any values .

name: VARP
description: The VARP function returns the population (true) variance—a measure of dispersion—of a set of numeric values.

name: VARPA
description: The VARPA function returns the population (true) variance—a measure of dispersion—of a set of any values .

name: VDB
syntax: VDB(cost, salvage, life, starting-per, ending-per, depr-factor, no-switch)
description: The VDB function returns the amount of depreciation of an asset over a chosen time interval, based on a specified depreciation rate.

name: VLOOKUP
description: The VLOOKUP function returns a value from a collection of columns by using the left column of values to pick a row and a column number to pick a column in that row.

name: VSTACK
description: The VSTACK function adjoins arrays vertically and in sequence to form a larger array.

name: WEEKDAY
description: The WEEKDAY function returns a number that is the day of the week for a given date/time value or date string .

name: WEEKNUM
description: The WEEKNUM function returns the number of the week within the year for a given date/time value or date string .

name: WEIBULL
description: The WEIBULL function returns the Weibull distribution of the specified type.

name: WORKDAY
description: The WORKDAY function returns the date/time value that is the given number of working days before or after a given date.

name: WRAPCOLS
description: The WRAPCOLS function converts the provided row or column of values into a two-dimensional array by wrapping values into separate columns.

name: WRAPROWS
description: The WRAPROWS function converts the provided row or column of values into a two-dimensional array by wrapping values into separate rows.

name: XIRR
description: The XIRR function returns the internal rate of return for an investment that is based on a series of irregularly spaced cash flows.

name: XLOOKUP
syntax: XLOOKUP(search-value, search-range, return-range, if-not-found, match-type, search-type)
description: The XLOOKUP function searches a range for a specified value and returns the value from the same row in another column.

name: XMATCH
description: The XMATCH function returns a specified item’s relative position in a range of cells.

name: XNPV
description: The XNPV function returns the present value of an investment or annuity based on a series of irregularly spaced cash flows and at a discount interest rate.

name: XOR
description: The XOR function returns the boolean value TRUE if an odd number of the arguments are true, and the boolean value FALSE otherwise.

name: YEAR
description: The YEAR function returns the year for a given date/time value or date string .

name: YEARFRAC
description: The YEARFRAC function returns the fraction of a year represented by the number of whole days between two dates.

name: YIELD
syntax: YIELD(settle, maturity, annual-rate, price, redemption, frequency, days-basis)
description: The YIELD function returns the effective annual interest rate for a security that pays regular periodic interest.

name: YIELDDISC
description: The YIELDDISC function returns the effective annual interest rate for a security that is sold at a discount to redemption value and pays no interest.

name: YIELDMAT
syntax: YIELDMAT(settle, maturity, issue, annual-rate, price, days-basis)
description: The YIELDMAT function returns the effective annual interest rate for a security that only pays interest at maturity.

name: ZTEST
description: The ZTEST function returns the one-tailed probability value of the Z-test.
